summary: PRJ-03 Project settings: implemented PATCH /api/v1/projects/:projectId allowing Workspace Owner and Project Managers to update project name and description. Enforces role restrictions (members/viewers rejected with 403 FORBIDDEN, outsiders with 404 NOT_FOUND), prevents managers from altering workspace ownership, and enforces Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) rejecting stale expectedVersion with 409 STALE_VERSION. All 15 integration tests in prj02-prj05.test.ts pass against local PostgreSQL.
limitations: Project archive and reopen actions are handled separately under PRJ-04 / PRJ-06.
